title: Stratton and Lacatski built OSAP together

tellings.quote: He and Lassky are the ones that built the OSAP program together. So it wasn't just Jim Lowsky alone. It was Jim and Jay and their support staff.

plain: In 2008 two men, Jay Stratton and Jim Lacatski, together built OSAP, a Defense Intelligence Agency programme that studied unexplained aerial phenomena. Eric W. Davis, a Pentagon scientist who says he worked alongside it, tells Michels that "it wasn't just Jim" Lacatski alone but "Jim and Jay and their support staff." He tells it to give Stratton his share of the credit for founding the programme.
